extracted_details.description_text: Version 120.8.4.0, dated 05/06/2026, is taken from the supplied INF. INFDescriptionData was semantically analyzed: it identifies the Surface ACPI device ACPI\MSHW0530, a demand-start SurfaceIntegrationDriver.sys service, Windows 10/11 and default power-policy packages, and registry data for display power estimation. No version-specific vendor release notes or matching download page were available to verify changes for this release, so the description is based on the supplied INF rather than inferred release changes. Some registry entries in the supplied INF are listed in a section whose installation linkage is not shown; their application should not be assumed solely from their presence.
key_components: SurfaceIntegrationDriver.sys, installed as a demand-start kernel driver for ACPI\MSHW0530.
Three power-policy package files: Surface.Power.Policy.Defaults.ppkg, Surface.Power.Policy.WIN10.Defaults.ppkg, and Surface.Power.Policy.WIN11-0.Defaults.ppkg.
A 14-point display backlight power curve with brightness and backlight-power values for Windows energy estimation.
key_functionalities: Associates the Surface integration driver with a Surface system device identified by ACPI\MSHW0530.
Provides default and OS-specific power-policy package references for Windows 10 and Windows 11.
Configures display backlight power-estimation curve data used by Windows energy estimation.
The INF defines a KIP-supported setting associated with power-saving features; its install applicability is not confirmed by the supplied section linkage.
The INF defines a setting to refresh the screen after a power-button long press; its install applicability is not confirmed by the supplied section linkage.
The INF defines BitLocker encryption, crypto, and decryption request limits; their install applicability is not confirmed by the supplied section linkage.
extracted_details.major_components_functionalities_descrip: The version basis is the supplied INF's DriverVer value, 120.8.4.0 dated 05/06/2026; no release-note version was available for comparison. INFDescriptionData was semantically analyzed and identifies a Surface system device at ACPI\MSHW0530, serviced by SurfaceIntegrationDriver.sys as a demand-start kernel driver. The package includes default, Windows 10, and Windows 11 power-policy provisioning packages. Its linked AddReg section supplies a 14-point backlight power curve for display energy estimation. Other supplied registry entries describe KIP power saving, long-press screen refresh, and BitLocker request tuning, but their installation linkage is not shown, so they are reported as defined settings rather than confirmed applied behavior.
impact_details: May affect Windows display energy estimates through the configured brightness-to-backlight-power curve.
May affect platform power behavior through the included OS-specific power-policy packages.
The INF defines a setting that may enable KIP power-saving support, but the supplied section linkage does not confirm that setting is applied.
The INF defines a long-press power-button screen-refresh setting, but the supplied section linkage does not confirm that setting is applied.
The INF defines higher BitLocker request limits that may affect SSD encryption I/O performance if those settings are installed; applicability is not established by the supplied section linkage.
